_field_guide.type: image | video | audio | text | chatbot | review | testimonial | endorsement
_field_guide.channel: youtube | tiktok | meta | facebook | instagram | threads | google_ads | website | blog | press_release | email | marketplace | linkedin | x
_field_guide.ai_involvement: none | assistive (standard editing: spelling, colour, crop, background clean-up) | partial (AI changed substance) | generated (AI produced the asset)
_field_guide.realistic: true if a person would reasonably take it for real footage, audio or photography
_field_guide.depicts_real_people: true if an identifiable real person appears or is voiced
_field_guide.synthetic_performer: true if a digitally created person appears as if a real performer
_field_guide.virtual_influencer: true if the endorser is an AI or CGI character
_field_guide.public_interest: true if the text informs the public on matters of public interest (news, policy, health, finance, elections)
_field_guide.human_review: true if a named person substantively reviewed it and could approve, alter or reject it
_field_guide.editorial_responsibility: true if a natural or legal person holds editorial responsibility for publication
_field_guide.own_generator_offered_to_others: true if you PROVIDE the generating AI system to others (EU provider marking duty)
_field_guide.political: true for social issue, electoral or political ads
_field_guide.material_connection: none | employee | paid | free_product | discount | affiliate | family
_field_guide.artistic_or_satirical: true for evidently artistic, creative, satirical or fictional works
_field_guide.regions: EU | US | US-NY | UK | IN (audience regions; US-NY implies US)
_field_guide.disclosures_present: ai_label | platform_ai_toggle | ai_interaction_notice | machine_readable_marking | synthetic_performer_disclosure | material_connection | ad_disclosure
